newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank to buy 20 pct interest in RSA.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank to buy 20 pct interest in RSA.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said on Wednesday that it has agreed to buy Scottish Equitable's 20 percent shareholding in RSA.

Royal Bank said RSA, which it set up with Scottish Equitable in 1989, has been a "successful venture for both shareholders". Royal Bank's chief executive, George Mathewson, said: "The product range now required by it is markedly different from that which Scottish Equitable now provides. It has, therefore, been agreed that we should now go our own ways after what has been a mutually rewarding relationship." It said that as part of the deal the administration, processing, investment management and other services currently provided by Scottish Equitable to RSA will terminate over the next two years or so.
These services will be transferred to a new third party provider on a phased basis.
